title.narrative: Multinational Nacala Road Corridor Development Project Phase V (Malawi)

description.narrative: Activities of the project are: (i) Rehabilitation of the 55km road between Nsipe and Liwonde towns in Malawi; (ii) Construction of a One-Stop-Border-Post (OSBP) between Malawi and Mozambique at the Chiponde/Mandimba Border Post; and (iii) Feasibility study and detailed engineering design of the 47 km road between Mangochi and Chiponde.

description.narrative: World Bank Logistics Performance Index infrastructure measures the quality of trade and transport infrastructure (e.g. ports, railways, roads, ICT, etc.).
